solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique after crossings); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Pasta served up in Turin or a campsite?

indicators.note: served up says the hidden letters are read backwards
in says the answer sits inside the following words, spanning their boundaries

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A query about whether pasta is served in an Italian city or at a campsite.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft left 'in' as a link, but it signals the hidden word. 'Served up' reverses, as this is a down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Macaroni is a type of tubular pasta, so the answer is an example of the definition.

clue.text: New rosette marks outstanding piece of skill

indicators.note: new tells us the letters of these two words are made into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A fresh rosette rewards an exceptional bit of skill, as at a show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'New' is the anagram signal on ROSETTEMARKS.
explanation.definitionFit: A masterstroke is a brilliantly clever, skilful move or action.

clue.text: IT expert breaking the ice

indicators.note: breaking says the letters of these words are broken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: A computer specialist starts a conversation, breaking the ice at a gathering.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Breaking' is the anagram signal on THEICE.
explanation.definitionFit: Techie is informal slang for a technically minded person, especially a computer specialist.

clue.text: Not quite finished bringing up fruit

indicators.note: not quite finished says the word loses its final letter

parts.note: bringing up a child is raising it

explanation.surface: Someone nearly done being sick after eating some fruit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not quite finished' removes the last letter G from RAISING.
explanation.definitionFit: A raisin is a dried grape, a kind of dried fruit.

clue.text: Country artist occupying home

indicators.note: occupying means one piece sits inside another, as a tenant does in a house

parts.note: being in is being at home
RA is a Royal Academician, a crossword stock for an artist

explanation.surface: A painter is living in a house in some country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Occupying' is the insertion signal; RA (Royal Academician) is the crossword's usual artist.
explanation.definitionFit: Iran is a nation in western Asia, so it is an example of a country.

clue.text: Somewhat papal, a ceremonial building, impressive

indicators.note: somewhat means only part of the following words is used, a stretch running across them

explanation.surface: A grand building that is partly papal, used for ceremony and impressive to look at.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer runs through 'pa(PAL A CE)remonial'; 'ceremonial' belongs to the wordplay, so the definition is the impressive building at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: A palace is a large and imposing residence or building, typically of a ruler.

clue.text: Maintain agreement must have right to replace name

indicators.note: must have, with to replace, says one letter is swapped for another in the word
to replace says the new letter takes the place of the one named

parts.note: assent is agreement or approval

explanation.surface: A demand that any agreement must swap a name for a right.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Must have right to replace name' turns ASSENT into the answer by putting R where N was.
explanation.definitionFit: To maintain a view is to assert it, stating it firmly as true.

clue.text: Weekend day — is overseeing workplace? OK

indicators.note: overseeing means sitting above, so in this down clue the earlier pieces come before the workplace

parts.note: Sat is the abbreviation for Saturday, a day of the weekend
a factory is a place where people work

explanation.surface: Someone checks whether supervising a workplace on a Saturday is acceptable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Overseeing' places SAT and IS above FACTORY in the down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: Satisfactory means acceptable or adequate, exactly the informal sense of OK.

clue.text: Only remaining part of a shoemaker's equipment

definitions.meaning: a foot-shaped block on which a shoemaker shapes shoes

explanation.surface: The sole surviving piece of a cobbler's kit.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both final or sole remaining and the cobbler's foot-shaped mould.

clue.text: "The Saint" unexpectedly wavering

indicators.note: unexpectedly says the letters of these words turn up in a surprising new order

explanation.surface: The hero of the TV show The Saint is surprisingly indecisive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Unexpectedly' is the anagram signal on THESAINT.
explanation.definitionFit: Hesitant means unsure and holding back, the same as wavering.

clue.text: Number of winding route in low-lying area

indicators.note: in places the winding route inside the low-lying area

parts.note: a fen is low-lying marshy land, as in the Fens of eastern England

indicators.note: winding says the letters of the word twist into a new order

explanation.surface: The number of a twisting road through flat marshland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Winding' scrambles ROUTE to OURTE and 'in' is the insertion signal. The Fens are flat marshland in eastern England.
explanation.definitionFit: Fourteen is a whole number, ten plus four, so it is an example of a number.

clue.text: Retreat regularly visited for period

indicators.note: regularly visited means only every other letter of the word is called on

explanation.surface: A retreat someone went to often over a stretch of time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Regularly visited' takes the 2nd, 4th and 6th letters of RETREAT.
explanation.definitionFit: An era is a long period of history marked by some character or event.

clue.text: At the outset seemingly anxious for everyone to be secure

indicators.note: at the outset points to the opening letter of each of the next words

explanation.surface: Someone who at first seems anxious that all should be protected.
explanation.walkthrough: 'At the outset' takes the first letters of 'seemingly anxious for everyone'.
explanation.definitionFit: Safe and secure both mean protected from harm or danger.

clue.text: Outrageous tirade after standard's shown

indicators.note: after says the tirade follows the standard in the answer

parts.note: a standard is a flag, and the 's stands for is
a rant is a long angry tirade

explanation.surface: An outrageous outburst once a regimental standard has been displayed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'After' orders the charade; 'shown' is just a link. A standard is a ceremonial flag carried by a regiment.
explanation.definitionFit: Flagrant means shockingly obvious or blatant, like an outrageous offence.

clue.text: Most important part of US soldier's time

parts.note: a GI is an American soldier, so GI's gives these letters

explanation.surface: The main point of an American soldier's period of service.
explanation.definitionFit: The gist of something is its essence or central point.

clue.text: Players on tour one left stranded?

parts.note: the cast is the group of players in a show
a touring company is away from home

explanation.surface: Actors travelling on tour, with one of them left behind somewhere.
explanation.definitionFit: A castaway is a shipwrecked person left marooned somewhere remote.

clue.text: False report prison to be located over a road

indicators.note: located over in a down clue means placed above, so this piece comes first

parts.note: can is slang for prison

explanation.surface: An untrue story that a jail is to be built above a road.
explanation.walkthrough: 'To be located over' sets CAN above A and RD in the down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: A canard is an unfounded rumour or hoax story.

clue.text: Quiet, slippery character pinching king's money

parts.note: sh is the call for quiet

indicators.note: pinching means holding something tight between the two parts, so the king goes inside

parts.note: an eel is a slippery fish, and also a slippery person
K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A sly, silent crook steals a monarch's cash.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pinching' is the insertion signal, with a pun on stealing; the slippery character is a fish.
explanation.definitionFit: The shekel is the currency of Israel and an ancient unit of money.

clue.text: Declare arrival of girl — not much to follow

indicators.note: to follow says the small amount comes after the girl in the answer

parts.note: Ann is a girl's name
an ounce is a tiny amount, as in not an ounce of sense

explanation.surface: Someone announces that a girl has come, with little else to come after.
explanation.definitionFit: To announce a guest is to proclaim their arrival, as a herald or butler does.

clue.text: Northern listener close by

parts.note: the ear is the organ that listens

explanation.surface: A northern eavesdropper is standing close at hand.
explanation.definitionFit: Near means at a short distance, the same as close by.

clue.text: Call time in school

definitions.meaning: one of the periods a school year is divided into

explanation.surface: Someone calls time on the school day.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means to name something; the noun is a division of the academic year.

clue.text: Move swiftly in profession

definitions.meaning: to rush along fast and out of control

explanation.surface: Getting ahead quickly in one's line of work.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means hurtle along; as a noun it is one's chosen line of work.

clue.text: Make mistake with task

parts.note: to err is to make a mistake
and means together with

explanation.surface: Getting something wrong while doing a chore.
explanation.definitionFit: An errand is a short job or trip to deliver or collect something, a small task.
